Entertainment.title: HYKE Reimagines Heritage Military Codes Across a Dual Gender Runway for SS27
Entertainment.text: SummaryHYKE SS27 debuts its first full menswear line alongside its latest womenswear collection.The range comprises tailored silhouettes, military-inspired outerwear and sheer layering.Collaborations include Baracuta jackets, BRIEFING modular totes, and footwear with FOOT THE COACHER, BEAUTIFUL SHOES, and Marbot.HYKE’s Spring/Summer 2027 runway collection continues Hideaki Yoshihara and Yukiko Ode’s exploration of modernized vintage uniforms and workwear, this time marking the debut of a fully developed menswear line alongside womenswear. Distinctly engineered rather than simply upsized from womenswear, both lines share cohesive silhouettes and thematic codes while maintaining distinct tailoring and fits.The season strikes a balance between sharp, elegant tailoring, voluminous drapes, utilitarian outerwear and delicate sheer layers rendered in a refined palette of dark blue, navy, indigo, black and beige. Key outerwear pieces draw directly from mid-century military equipment, including PERTEX® M-65 field jackets, M-48 fishtail parkas, and spring flight blousons inspired by the USAF CWU-36/P, CWU-106/P, and L-2A silhouettes.Slit-sleeve double-breasted blazers and lapelless jackets add a modern edge, styled alongside ankle-cropped wool-mohair trousers and wide-leg M-51 Arctic-inspired drawstring pants. Light layers feature layered US Navy utility shirts, gradient-striped Basque sweaters, sheer knits, and heavy Tilden sweaters paired with sheer pleated skirts. The collection is further elevated by a collaboration with British heritage brand Baracuta, which reimagines the iconic G9 jacket and British Army Desert Storm Coat in high-density "Baracuta Cloth" lined with a custom beige and black Fraser Tartan.The collection also introduces a series of collaborations that expand HYKE’s design language. A partnership with Baracuta reworks the iconic G9 jacket with a custom beige-and-black Fraser Tartan lining, echoed across shirting and dresses. Accessories include modular tote bags created with BRIEFING, featuring detachable pouches inspired by US Army ALICE packs, and jewelry developed with END CUSTOM JEWELLERS, transforming metal plates and chains into earrings, rings, and necklaces. Footwear collaborations span elegant tassel loafer slides and versatile Ghurka sandals by FOOT THE COACHER and BEAUTIFUL SHOES, alongside sneakers with Marbot, inspired by French Navy training shoes. With fabrics ranging from SOLOTEX® and taslan to sheer wool and crochet knits, and a palette of navy, indigo, black, and beige, HYKE SS27 presents a cohesive yet richly layered vision of contemporary uniform dressing.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Glastonbury 2027 Is Officially Happening With Tickets Breaking £400 GBP for the First Time in History
Entertainment.text: SummaryGlastonbury Festival returns in 2027 with weekend tickets breaking the £400 barrier for the first timePasses for the flagship cultural event will officially go on sale in October 2026 following a fallow yearOrganiser Emily Eavis has confirmed that three major headliners are already locked in for the comebackFollowing a scheduled fallow year in 2026, the legendary Glastonbury Festival has officially set the stage for its return, confirming both the dates and a record-breaking price point for its 2027 edition. Slated to run from Wednesday, 23 June to Sunday, 27 June, the expansive cultural gathering will demand a heavier financial commitment from attendees. For the first time in the event's history, standard pricing has shattered the £400 GBP barrier. General admission weekend passes are now locked in at £408 GBP, a figure that includes a mandatory £5 GBP booking fee per ticket. This historic high represents a sharp increase of £29.50 GBP compared to the rates charged for the 2025 event, cementing the sprawling Somerset site's reputation as the most expensive music festival in the United Kingdom. Buyers must also account for additional, unfinalised postage and packing fees on top of the base price tag.This aggressive pricing recalibration is the starkest reflection yet of a broader trend currently reshaping the live music ecosystem. Across the landscape of major UK festivals, the cost of admission has relentlessly surged past the standard rate of inflation. Event organisers are battling an unprecedented confluence of macroeconomic pressures, attributing these steep cost hikes to skyrocketing energy and infrastructure expenditures compounded by severe post-Brexit labour shortages. As the flagship event of the British summer, the new pricing model for 2027 effectively normalises this heightened barrier to entry for top-tier live music, shifting the financial reality for an entire generation of festivalgoers.Securing a spot on the farm for Glastonbury remains a notoriously fierce battle, and the October 2026 on-sale rollout will be split into two distinct ticketing phases. Those willing to commit to sustainable transit can strike first, as tickets packaged with coach travel will officially drop at 6:00 p.m. BST on Thursday, October 1. The wider scramble for standard general admission tickets will then commence at 9:00 am. BST on Sunday, October 4. To participate in either release, strict preliminary hurdles must be cleared. Anyone who will be aged 13 or over on June 23, 2027 is required to register for free in advance to become eligible to purchase a ticket. Furthermore, in an ongoing bid to prevent secondary market touting, the passes remain strictly non-transferable and will prominently feature a photograph of the registered ticket holder printed directly on the physical pass.Anticipation for the massive 2027 comeback is already mounting, especially given the monumental scale of the festival's previous iteration. The legendary gathering last took place in 2025, boasting a massive lineup that saw pop phenomenon Olivia Rodrigo, British rock outfit The 1975 and heritage icon Neil Young topping the bill across the weekend. While the full roster for the upcoming return remains tightly under wraps, Glastonbury organiser Emily Eavis has already confirmed that the festival has successfully booked all three primary headliners for 2027. Despite rampant internet speculation, Eavis has explicitly stated that pop royalty Madonna will not be among that trio, leaving fans to speculate on who will command the UK's most expensive stages next.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: UNDERCOVER and George Cox Reinterpret the 4 Eyelet Derby Through Cindy Sherman's Photography
Entertainment.text: Name: UNDERCOVER x Cindy Sherman x George Cox 4 Eyelet DerbyColorway: Black, WhiteSKU: N/AMSRP: $450 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: George CoxGeorge Cox and UNDERCOVER have again joined forces on the 4 Eyelet Derby, extending a partnership that runs through Jun Takahashi's label and George Cox's Northamptonshire workshop. For Fall/Winter 2026, the two houses hand the silhouette over to American artist Cindy Sherman, whose photographic studies of identity become the surface of the shoe itself.The construction stays true to George Cox's house methods. Both colorways are built on the 1353 last, a traditional Northamptonshire round-toe form that the brand pushes into something tougher than its heritage silhouettes suggest. A lightweight EVA sole underpins each pair, while steel eyelets handle the four-eyelet lacing that gives the derby its name. Inside, the shoes are finished with natural kip lining leather, the industrially stamped interior that George Cox treats as part of its signature handwriting.Rather than dyeing or embossing the leather, George Cox and UNDERCOVER photo-print it, wrapping Sherman's images around the full body of the shoe so the artwork reads as a continuous surface with its focal point resting on the toe. Sherman built her reputation on staged self-portraits that cast herself in shifting personas, using the camera to interrogate how identity is constructed and performed. That preoccupation with self-image maps neatly onto UNDERCOVER's own history of subversion.The two colorways draw on different works from her catalog. The white pair carries Untitled #122, made in 1983, while the black pair pulls from her earlier film-still period, featuring Untitled Film Still #16 from 1979 and Untitled Film Still #53 from 1980. Across both, the source imagery spans 1979 to 1983, turning the derby into a wearable slice of one of the most influential bodies of work in contemporary American photography.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Sports.title: Phil Jackson Is Getting a Statue in Star Plaza, Joining Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal Outside the Arena
Sports.text: SummaryLos Angeles Lakers to honor Hall of Fame head coach Phil Jackson with a statue outside Crypto.com Arena in April 2027Monument celebrates an 11-season tenure that delivered five NBA championships and a legendary three-peatThe Los Angeles Lakers officially announced on Tuesday that Phil Jackson will be honored with a statue in Star Plaza outside Crypto.com Arena. This unveiling ceremony is scheduled for April 9, 2027, taking place just before the Lakers face off against the Minnesota Timberwolves. Jackson is 80 years old and will become the ninth figure immortalized outside the arena. His physical legacy will be cemented alongside the franchise icons he once led.The monument celebrates an era of dominance. Jackson originally arrived in Los Angeles after accepting an invitation from late Lakers owner Jerry Buss. He coached the Lakers for 11 seasons across two separate stints from 1999 to 2004 and 2005 to 2011. His tenure focused on championship execution. Under his watch, the Lakers compiled a 610-292 regular-season record and an equally lethal 118-63 run in the playoffs. Los Angeles reached the postseason in every one of his 11 seasons at the helm and advanced to the NBA Finals seven times. Jackson delivered five championships to Los Angeles, including three consecutive NBA titles from 2000 to 2002.Before building his West Coast dynasty, Jackson was already a certified architect of basketball history, having secured six NBA titles as the head coach of the Chicago Bulls. He was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame in 2007. In Star Plaza, his monument will join an exclusive club of eight figures: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Elgin Baylor, Kobe Bryant, Chick Hearn, Magic Johnson, Shaquille O'Neal, Pat Riley and Jerry West. His most recent public appearances at Lakers games were to witness the statue unveilings for Bryant and O'Neal, the pillars of his inaugural Los Angeles three-peat. Lakers Governor Jeanie Buss, who is also Jackson’s former fiancee, provided the official quote in the press release regarding the new monument.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
